findings.title: Plan documents contain only the unedited scaffold comment
findings.why: The three new plan files (1-2, 1-3, 1-4) have no plan body, only the template placeholder comment that says to replace it. The `element` and `parent` frontmatter fields are also empty.

findings.title: Leftover scaffold comment and missing heading in task doc
findings.why: The template placeholder comment was not removed from task-001, task-002 and task-004. Unlike the other task files, task-004 has no `# Bulk import tasks` heading.
